notes.title: Patch 1.58
notes.notes:
- most weapon skills reworked to be more effective in exchange for cooldown
- two hand hammer animation fixed
- Incision fixed
- fixed ai learning certain skills that go past lvl 5
- ai additionall freeze bugs fixed
- hand of justice nerfed
- ai no longer fails to use weapon skills

notes.title: Patch 1.57
notes.notes:
- two hand style fixed
- Fire storm placement visible
- Ai doesnt freeze on using Ice breath (Dragon turtle fix)
- Skills can now be viewed in the charachter selection screen

notes.title: Patch 1.56
notes.notes:
- undead skill unlock bug fixed
- item popup is slightly more visible and lasts longer
- Lightning rod made less strong early on
- Shield bash freeze bug fixed

notes.title: Update 1.55
notes.notes:
- starting fame for standard difficulty has been raised to 5 to allow hiring a second hero from start, making it slightly easier through the first few maps
- starting difficulty options are fixed
- Crafting screen will no longer have items dissapear
- other minor fixes
